novelty_flags.label: ChernozhukovWuthrichZhu2026 bibliography and related-work comparison
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited 2026 JPE article is titled “Debiasing and t-Tests for Synthetic Control Inference on Average Causal Effects,” whereas the core attributes the earlier aggregate-panel working-paper title to that publication.

soundness_flags.label: def:panel-model-class and thm:uniform-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: The class is defined as tuples of group laws and full triangular sequences, but the theorem takes an infimum over a single P and writes Pr_P without defining the induced joint observable sample law.

soundness_flags.label: def:two-donor-switch, def:np-confidence-rule, and prop:maximum-hull-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: Z is globally a p-dimensional stacked score-effect observation but is reused as an unspecified two-score vector in the switch experiment, leaving the coordinates in D=Z_2-Z_1 ambiguous.

soundness_flags.label: prop:single-label-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed q=0 reduction is not a specialization of the declared model, where q is a fixed positive integer.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nonempty-close-set and ass:close-label-coherence
soundness_flags.one_line: Exact population score equality together with exact untreated-trend transport is load-bearing, but the justification gives neither a credible design construction nor observable evidence that this conjunction holds in the CMS workflow.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 305–358, Abstract and Introduction, especially Section I
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies inference on the true effect of a selected winner, develops conditional, unconditional, and hybrid confidence intervals, and describes projection as less precise.
The article characterizes minimax expected-measure confidence sets by duality and gives explicit one-dimensional restricted-normal examples.
The paper obtains universal post-selection confidence intervals through simultaneous inference across candidate submodels and notes the resulting conservatism.

The paper introduces a sufficient statistic for an infinite-dimensional nuisance in a Gaussian problem and conditional tests with uniformly correct asymptotic size without identification-strength assumptions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: publication front matter and paper title, pp. 287–333
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited paper is the published GMM uniform-subvector-inference result for possible identification failure.
The paper develops adaptive confidence intervals for linear functionals using between-class moduli and expected-length lower bounds.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 41(6), 2013
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes Gaussian and multiplier-bootstrap approximation for maxima of high-dimensional sums, including estimated covariance settings.
The paper gives inference for few treated and many control groups under heteroskedasticity induced by unequal group sizes.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Political Economy, ahead of print, 2026

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define one observable joint law P_n=⊗_r P_{r,n}^{n_r}, make M_n a class of those joint laws or triangular arrays, and rewrite every uniform probability using that object.
Separate the switch-experiment observation from the panel Gaussian vector, declare its score dimension and coordinate map explicitly, and permit q=0 if the single-label Wald reduction is retained.

Replace the exact-close causal premise with a primitive transport model linking the score to untreated post changes, state diagnostics or a realistic calibration design that can produce exact score equality, and bind all causal conclusions to that conditional regime.

For the general frontier, give a worked J=2 or J=3 correlated score-effect instance that embeds the switch experiment in the full stacked Gaussian model before attempting the arbitrary-face dual program.

recommended_next_step: Revise the model-law semantics, notation and q-domain, repair the CWZ citation, and substantiate or explicitly narrow the exact-close transport regime before advancing to Stage 0.
